title: More ways to invest with Wealthfront’s Brokerage Account
summary: Invest on your terms with more choice, more control, and instant trades across a range of 8,000+ newly added stocks and ETFs.
body_markdown:
Today, we’re excited to share new features in our Brokerage Account, expanding on the investing experience previously offered through the Stock Investing Account, including instant trading, recurring investments, and limit orders. It’s now easier than ever to invest on your terms with **more choices, more control, and instant trades** (when markets are open) across an expanded range of 8,000+ newly added stocks and ETFs. Here’s a look at what’s new:


- Recurring investments: Automatically invest on a schedule you determine
- Trade instantly: Buy, sell, and reinvest immediately during market hours
- Set limit orders: Choose to buy or sell when the price of a security reaches a certain level
- Share-denominated orders: Buy or sell a specific number of shares, rather than a dollar amount
- 8,000+ additional ETFs and stocks: Explore newly added securities by category or search for the ones you already know


## **A surprisingly simple Brokerage Account**


We designed our Brokerage Account to be the easiest place to buy and hold ETFs and stocks. As we worked to improve the Brokerage Account, we saw an opportunity to provide our clients with a much simpler investing experience than was available elsewhere.


Even if you’ve never invested before, the product makes it easy to get started by browsing categories of popular and industry-specific ETFs and stocks before you buy. And because our Brokerage Account and Cash Account work together, you can buy ETFs and stocks in just a few taps, for as little as $1—your cash earns an industry-leading APY in the Cash Account until you’re ready to invest. As a result, your money keeps working for you, even when it’s not in the market.


Whether you’re new to investing or simply want to add ETFs and stocks to your existing portfolio, the Brokerage Account makes this easy. And, as we continue to build a future that favors people over institutions, we’ll continue to expand our product suite to meet our clients’ evolving needs. This includes offering Joint Brokerage Accounts and Trust Brokerage Account, adding support for a Portfolio Line of Credit, and providing even more flexibility in how you invest, with more to come.
